lit.\u0027¿Cuál tiene mayor prioridad entre: "Which has the highest priority among Br, Cl, F and I?"
lit.\u0027¿Es estereocentro un carbono con d: "Is a carbon with two hydrogens (–CH₂–) a stereocenter?"
lit.\u0027¿Qué tienen en común dos enantióme: "What do two enantiomers have in common?"
lit.\u0027\u003cp class=\"small\"\u003eMarca:
"

We place ④ at the back with the camera; decide the direction 1→2→3. Correct: "
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eCon –CH₂OH, –CH=CH₂,:
"

With –CH₂OH, –CH=CH₂, –CH₃ and –H the three carbons tie at Z = 6. Their substituents are compared: CH₂OH (O,H,H) > CH=CH₂ (C,C,H) > CH₃ (H,H,H), because the first point of difference is O > C. The double bond is duplicated: C=C counts as (C,C).

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eLa \u003cb\u003eimage:
"

The mirror image of an R center is S. Swapping any two substituents also inverts the configuration. Enantiomers have the same physical properties (m.p., b.p., solubility) except that they rotate the plane of polarized light in opposite directions, and they react differently with other chiral molecules (receptors, enzymes).

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eRecorre \u003cb\u003e:
"

Trace 1 → 2 → 3. If the turn is clockwise, the center is R; if it is counterclockwise, it is S. The arrow shows the turn. This case: Br → Cl → F seen with H at the back.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eReglas de \u003cb\u00:
"

Cahn–Ingold–Prelog rules: priority 1 to 4 is assigned according to the atomic number of the atom directly bonded to the stereocenter: Br (35) > Cl (17) > F (9) > H (1). If there is a tie, the next set of atoms is compared (stage 6).

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eSe orienta la molécul:
"

The molecule is oriented so that the priority 4 substituent (H) points away from the observer. The camera is placed opposite the H: you see the other three substituents arranged around the center.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eUn \u003cb\u003ecentr:
"

A stereogenic center (stereocenter) is an atom with four different substituents. It exists in two spatial arrangements that are non-superimposable mirror images: the enantiomers. Here CHFClBr: C bonded to H, F, Cl and Br. Rotate the molecule with the mouse and compare it with its mirror image.

"
lit.\u0027adivina R o S para compuestos alea: "guess R or S for random compounds."
lit.\u0027Ambos empiezan en C; sus conjuntos: "Both start with C; their sets are (O,H,H) and (C,C,H): O > C at the first point of difference."
lit.\u0027Barras: Z del primer átomo; el pun: "Bars: Z of the first atom; the dotted line marks the sum of Z of its substituents (tie-breaker)."
lit.\u0027CIP: prioridad por \u003cb\u003enú: "CIP: priority by atomic number; if tied, next sphere."
lit.\u0027Con el sustituyente de menor prior: "With the lowest-priority substituent at the back, 1→2→3 turns clockwise. The configuration is…"
lit.\u0027el sustituyente de cada posición,: 'the substituent at each position, swap 1↔2, show mirror and the view from opposite ④.'
lit.\u0027indican la prioridad ①–④ de cada s: "indicate the priority ①–④ of each substituent."
lit.\u0027Intercambia dos sustituyentes: la: 'Swap two substituents: the configuration is inverted.'
lit.\u0027Menor prioridad \u003cb\u003eatrás: "Lowest priority at the back; 1→2→3 clockwise = R, counterclockwise = S."
lit.\u0027Mira desde el lado opuesto al sust: "Look from the side opposite the lowest-priority substituent"
lit.\u0027Muestra el espejo: el enantiómero: 'Show the mirror: the enantiomer has the opposite configuration.'
lit.\u0027No, porque tiene dos sustituyentes: "No, because it has two identical substituents"
lit.\u0027Ordena por prioridad CIP: –OH, –CH: "Order by CIP priority: –OH, –CH₃, –NH₂, –H (from highest to lowest)."
lit.\u0027R/S no indica signo de rotación óp: "R/S does not indicate the sign of optical rotation (+/−)."
lit.\u0027Si el primer átomo empata, se mira: "If the first atom ties, the next set is examined"
lit.\u0027Si en un centro R se intercambian: "If two substituents are swapped at an R center, the center becomes…"
lit.\u0027Sigue la lección o elige los cuatr: "Follow the lesson or choose the four substituents in “Lab”. The “From opposite ④” view places the camera as the CIP rule requires."
lit.\u0027Sólo si está unido a oxígeno\u0027: "Only if it is bonded to oxygen"
lit.\u0027Son imágenes especulares no superp: "They are non-superimposable mirror images; they rotate the plane of polarized light in opposite directions."
lit.\u0027Todas las propiedades físicas exce: "All physical properties except the direction of optical rotation"
lit.\u0027Un carbono con cuatro sustituyente: "A carbon with four different substituents is chiral"
lit.\u0027Un intercambio de dos sustituyente: "Swapping two substituents is equivalent to the mirror image: R ↔ S."
lit.\u0027Usa la vista desde el lado opuesto: 'Use the view from opposite ④ and follow 1→2→3: clockwise means R.'
